current_detail: The current 75 x 150 mm two-PCB model keeps UI, all direct buttons, encoder, USB, an 8-bit 32-MHz i8080 display transmit path and the independent BT.656 camera receive path local to S3. Hub RP uses 46/48 GPIO with GPIO6 and GPIO47 reserved; rear RP uses 45/48 with three reserves. The exact 80-contact M1 map closes 25 live signals, fourteen 3V3_MAIN contacts, two AON contacts, twenty-five returns and fourteen NC reserves while staying below the 0.4-A contact rating at the 4.25-A step. Four 11-mm compression stops, anti-shear datums and independent PCB capture keep M1 electrical/alignment-only. The generated four-face mock-up places each directly viewed turned-over inner face below its exterior and audits all antenna/silkscreen/service geometry. Stable UI/RF-PWR role, R2-EVT1 build stage and PCB REV A identifiers are printed on the exterior; the changing H1-R2.xx work marker is documentation-only. Official Sinopine SP331R-MANUAL-V1.0 controls 28.7 x 23.1 mm nominal XY, 2.54-mm contact pitch and 1.4-mm edge offset for the matching SP331RX family. The sole H1 blocker remains fail-closed: obtain formal K331-to-SP331RX production equivalence or an AKK-native package, plus maximum Z/tolerances, recommended land/paste and packaging/soldering/reflow evidence. Purchasing, KiCad and fabrication remain unauthorized.
